subject: IRP walkthrough request + evidence retention / handback clarifications
messages:
From: Diane Lee <diane.lee@acmepayments.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmepayments.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Request: IRP walkthrough + SIG/CAIQ evidence retention questions

Hi Soojin,

We’re finalizing our vendor security review for Redwood and have a couple of asks before procurement can approve the PO. Can your team provide: 

- A short (30-60m) walkthrough of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) and escalation paths (for our SOC team)
- A list of the SIG/CAIQ/SOC 2 artifacts you can provide during onboarding and what you retain vs. hand back to customers after an incident
- Clarification on evidence retention exceptions (e.g., if we request log extracts for a regulated investigation, do you maintain copies or hand over extracts?)

We’d like the walkthrough next week if possible; our preferred windows are Wed/Thu 10–11am PT. Our timelines are tight: procurement would like the needed evidence to be available in your portal or via secure transfer before 30 Sep so we can close the PO.

Attached the high-level SIG questions we started filling out — a few are specific to evidence retention.

Thanks,
Diane
Diane Lee
Director, Security Assurance
Acme Payments

Attachment: ACME_SIG_questions.xlsx (spreadsheet; 46 KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Diane Lee <diane.lee@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IRP walkthrough + SIG/CAIQ evidence retention questions

Hi Diane — thanks for the note and the spreadsheet. We can absolutely run the walkthrough and clarify retention/handback behavior. Quick plan: 

- I’ll lead the IRP walkthrough (30–45m) and Marissa will cover evidence handling and artifacts. Karthik will join for any telemetry/logging details.
- We can do Wed 10–10:45am PT — does that work? Otherwise Thu 10–10:45am is also available.
- We’ll prepare a short snapshot of the IRP and a redacted example post-incident summary we can share after the call.
- Regarding retention: Redwood keeps raw telemetry for X days by default (we’ll confirm exact retention windows for account-level logs in the call) and we provide sanitized extracts on request. If Acme requires copies for regulatory reasons we can arrange a secure export and retention policy via an SLA addendum — we’ll outline options.

I’ve attached the IRP snapshot we typically share with customers and an internal doc that lists the common artifacts we can provide during onboarding. If there are specific artifacts in your spreadsheet you want prioritized, point them out and we’ll include those in the prep.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_irp_snapshot_v1.pdf (PDF; 120 KB) | ir_logs_export_instructions.md (text; 4 KB)

- Artifacts we would like to see or have clarified: S3 access logs for the account (last 90 days), API request audit logs (retention policy and sample extracts), SOC 2 SIG evidence map, and an example redacted post-incident report.

We will upload a short procurement note with our PO and timeline to the DocuSign envelope referenced below; please confirm if Redwood needs a separate MSA/Retention addendum signed prior to evidence exports.

Looking forward — thanks for coordinating.

Diane

Subject: Re: Request: IRP walkthrough + SIG/CAIQ evidence retention questions — confirmed and materials

Diane — confirmed for Wed 10:00–10:45am PT (calendar invite sent). Agenda: 1) IRP high-level walkthrough (Soojin) 2) Evidence & artifacts (Marissa) 3) Telemetry/logging specifics (Karthik) 4) Next steps and any retention addendum discussion (all).

I’ve attached the pre-call packet we’ll share: 
- redwood_irp_snapshot_v1.pdf — IRP summary and escalation ladder
- ir_logs_export_instructions.md — how we generate secure, redacted exports and the formats we support
- redwood_irp_summary_postcall.pdf — a redacted example post-incident summary we can use for reference after the call

High-level answers to your pre-call questions: 
- Default retention: account-level API/audit logs = 90 days, S3 access logs = 180 days. We can extend retention by request with a contract addendum.
- Evidence handback: we provide vetted, redacted extracts by default. For customer-requested copies for regulatory reasons we offer a certified export process (hashing + chain-of-custody notes) and can store a customer-owned encrypted bundle for an agreed retention window. This requires a short SLA addendum and a secure transfer workflow (we typically use SFTP or a secure presigned S3 transfer).
- Artifacts we can provide immediately: SOC 2 Type II report summary, SIG evidence mapping workbook, IRP summary, example redacted post-incident report. For telemetry extracts (S3 logs, API audit logs) we’ll need a signed export request and a retention addendum if you want Redwood to hold copies beyond our standard retention.

Next steps: confirm attendees and add any specific artifact priorities from ACME’s spreadsheet. We’ll be prepared to share the SOC/SIG mapping and a template export request form on the call.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_irp_snapshot_v1.pdf | ir_logs_export_instructions.md | redwood_irp_summary_postcall.pdf
